item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your calendar is full of reminders about shifting perspective, breaking negative patterns, and checking whether you're projecting or mind reading. Those only work if you catch the thought in the moment. Notice when a story forms about what someone else is thinking, and ask what you actually know versus what you're assuming. Your meditation and evening relaxation give you practice at that. Action: at four o'clock, write down one assumption and test it against the facts.
